questions.prompt: Which trading company effectively governed large parts of India?
questions.fact: It maintained an army roughly twice the size of the British Army before the Crown took direct control in 1858.

questions.prompt: Which subatomic particles make up a proton?
questions.fact: Their combined mass accounts for only a small fraction of the proton's. The rest is the energy binding them.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2016 Summer Olympics?
questions.fact: It was the first Games held in South America, and the first in the southern hemisphere's winter.

questions.prompt: Which board game involves solving a murder at Tudor Mansion?
questions.fact: It was invented during the Second World War by a British clerk to pass the time during air raids.

questions.prompt: Which river forms much of the border between Germany and France?
questions.fact: Its course has been straightened so heavily since the 1800s that it is now roughly eighty kilometres shorter.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set aboard a Mississippi raft?
questions.fact: It has been among the most frequently banned books in American schools since the year it was published.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the first widely adopted smartphone touchscreen keyboard?
questions.fact: Its predictive correction was what made a glass keyboard usable, and it was considered the riskiest part of the design.
